units.source_text: 即使是沙子，也有几乎完全相反的一面！……

en.t: Even sand has an almost completely opposite side to it! ...

units.source_text: 比如，反其道而行之，利用这种性质，制作铸模……

en.t: For example, by doing the reverse and making use of that property, one can make casting molds ...

units.source_text: 而且，它又是凝固混凝土所不可缺少的原料……

en.t: And besides, it is also an indispensable raw material for hardening concrete ...

units.source_text: 此外，在杀菌、除草方面也有可利用的方便之处，正在进行无菌耕作及单纯耕作的研究……

en.t: In addition, it has useful conveniences for sterilization and weed control, and research is underway into sterile cultivation and simple cultivation ...

units.source_text: 还有，使用某种土壤分解酵素，把沙子变成土壤的实验，好像也正在进行呀……沙子呀，一句话……）

en.t: There also seem to be experiments underway using a certain soil-decomposing enzyme to turn sand into soil ... Sand, in a word ... )
